title: 只能取消通告  (We Have to Cancel the Booking)

segments.t: Panic hits Xingtian when Yin Zhengyu signs with the rival show. Bu Xiaogu immediately calls younger brother Yin Jiaxi's agent to activate her backup plan — only to receive a crushing blow. Listen first.
怎么了，杏子姐？
尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
明天就要录节目了，那咱们怎么办啊？
又不是只有一套方案。
喂，你好，我是星天娱乐的布小谷。
现在我们已经确定要跟尹家希先生合作了。
我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
为什么？
他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
Now let's walk through the crisis and the phone call.
怎么了，杏子姐？
'What happened, Sister Xingzi?' Whenever someone rushes in with bad news, "zenme" in "zenme le" plus their name is the most natural expression for asking what went wrong.
尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。

'Yin Zhengyu cannot come to our side; obviously someone leaked the news.' Notice "lai bu liao": here "liao" (not "le") follows "lai bu" to say circumstances make it impossible to come, and "xiaoxi" means 'news'.
明天就要录节目了，那咱们怎么办啊？
'We are taping the show tomorrow — what do we do now?' Pairing "mingtian", 'tomorrow', with "jiu yao... le" stresses how close the deadline is — 'as soon as tomorrow!'.
又不是只有一套方案。
'It is not as if we only have one plan.' Reassuring "you bushi", 'it isn't as though', reminds Xiaogu of "zhiyou", 'only have', and measure word "tao" for a complete set or plan.
喂，你好，我是星天娱乐的布小谷。
'Hello, this is Bu Xiaogu from Xingtian Entertainment.' Answering or opening a telephone call starts with "wei" (pronounced rising second tone on the phone), followed immediately by "ni hao".
现在我们已经确定要跟尹家希先生合作了。
'We have now confirmed that we want to work with Mister Yin Jiaxi.' Polite "xiansheng" after a man's name means 'Mister', and "hezuo" is the standard word for collaborating or working together.
我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
'There is no way our Jiaxi can work with Xingtian anymore.' Strong "bu keneng" slams the door shut: "keneng" means 'possible', so "bu keneng" means 'impossible'.
为什么？
'Why?' Three syllables every beginner needs by heart: "weishenme", literally 'for what', asks 'why?'.
他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。

'He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.' Useful "zhineng", 'can only', shows having no other choice, and "quxiao" means cancel an appointment, flight, or TV booking "tonggao". Now listen to the whole phone-call crisis once more.
怎么了，杏子姐？
尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
明天就要录节目了，那咱们怎么办啊？
又不是只有一套方案。
喂，你好，我是星天娱乐的布小谷。
现在我们已经确定要跟尹家希先生合作了。
我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
为什么？
他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
Both Yin Zhengyu and Yin Jiaxi are blocked by the rival's exclusive clause, and Xiaogu blames herself. You learned phone greeting "wei", "lai bu liao", "weishenme", and "quxiao".
下次见！
